meta.note: Public acknowledgement wall. ADD A LENDER HERE ONLY IF THEY OPTED IN TO PUBLIC LISTING on the offer form (acknowledgement = 'public' or 'both'). 'credit_as' is their own wording where they supplied it — use it verbatim. Remove an entry immediately on request; there is no approval step and no archive. Do not add client names or dollar figures anywhere in this file.

fields.credit_as: displayed name, exactly as the lender wrote it
fields.contribution: what they lent, in plain words, optional
